name: read_experience
description: Read ONE experience-recall record by its record id — returns the normalized record plus its source anchors (spec/scope refs, kind, trust, lifecycle state, freshness) exactly as emitted by the experience-recall.sh bash twin. Obtain the record id from `search_experience` first. READ-ONLY: this tool adds NO scoring, NO freshness computation, and NO source validation of its own; it shells out to the twin and returns its stdout/stderr/exit code verbatim. A record id that is unknown, or a repo whose experience-recall adapter is disabled (adapter=none, twin exit 5), surfaces as a structured error result rather than a fake empty success — treat isError=true as 'the read did not happen', never as 'no such experience'. Reading never mutates the record, the lifecycle ledger, or the source artifact; the mutating subcommands (sync, admit, delete, lifecycle, export) are deliberately CLI-only and are NOT reachable from MCP.

record_id.description: The record id to read, as returned by search_experience. Must not begin with '--'.

format.description: Output format. Defaults to json (the machine-readable record payload). Use text for the human-readable rendering.
